Simply because she's in the mood for it, she's spent the past few hours organizing her thoughts with her ravens, Irynx takes to the soapbox.

"Arcanians, all of you, my name is Irynx Berlio and I am asking you to sign. A stroke of a pen to set the stones of what will be our brand new nation.

No. Not stones.

"There was a saying, when I was a young girl. 'When the rain comes, hearts of stone will wear away and hearts of iron will rust, but hearts of clay will blossom and bloom.' We build not stone or iron, but soil and clay. We are not crafting a sword, but tending to a garden. Delicate work, careful work, beautiful.

"Freedom is red, and war is its price. It is one we will fight to pay for the possibility of a nation. When we are free, what better weight to replace the rifles on our shoulders with the heads of those who have lost in pain?

"I believe the proposal Captain Midask and Miss Catla is what makes this possible. This, the United States of Arcania, the Empire of Refuge and Comfort. An hour remains to dig the foundation. Arcanians, all of you, I ask you to sign."

There's a moment of quiet as she reaches the end of her speech, then squeaks in embarassment. In a flash of white feathers, she turns into a raven and flies off into the stands.
<@!366565198284324868> that was adorable and so well put... you did so well ❤️
Vivica goes to Irynx "That was beautifully said. You have been a tremendous help to us with this proposal and throughout the debates entirely. I'm very happy to call you a friend."

Eliot finishes his read through and looks around to for Vivica to ask a question, but finds his answer before finding her. 

He makes his way over to where the signatures are being taken and takes hold of the quill, his hand shaking violently as he goes to write his name. Willow bites into his arm, and rather than recoiling in pain Eliot utters a quiet thank you as it seems to calm his hand long enough to sign his name is a beautiful script that falters on the last two letters. He quickly walks away, almost forgetting to leave the quill.

Eliot makes his way quietly over to Demetrius, his hands fidgeting once more. "Ex-excuse me? Mr. Demetrius?" He asks meekly, his voice barely above a whisper and easily lost in the din of the hall.
Demetrius looks down and smiles. "Eliot, my dear friend. What can I do for you?"

After a long while of thought and discussion Demetrius, Paddy, and Sutri will eventually sign though the twins will refuse. "I'm sorry Mr Midask." Says Prosser. "We respect what you're doing, we really do. But one government for all of Arcania seems like too much power, even if it is divided up as elegantly as you've portrayed it. We... we have a lot of experience with that much power being used it hurtful ways." Trapero and Prosser look at each other, a painful memory flashing across their faces. "I do hope we can continue to work together to drive the redcoats out of our land and build a peaceful future for all of Arcania's peoples." They will both thank Finn and Vivica for their work and shake their hands before leaving, seeming stoic but clearly still remembering a painful memory. Their arms are wrapped around each other and are leaning on each other for mutual support.

Eliot has a hard time looking directly at Demetrius and continues to fidget as he reaches into his pocket. "I-I was g-going to write you tomorrow... there was... is... there *is* something I wanted to ask you about, but this.... not the place... ummm sorry... if you're not busy... tomorrow could you come by the c-cafè? S-so we can talk... ummm but I know you're import- important so if you're to busy..." He  holds out an unlabeled envelope towards Demetrius as he tries to fight the shaking of his hands.

Demetrius will congratulate Vivica on all her hard work and give a bow. "I am glad to see you were able to expand upon the topics i had questions about." He pauses for a moment. "Would you care for some tea? What you did is quite stressful indeed and i believe i have just the blend that could help."

Eliot's shaking lessens the closer to the cafe they get, and with the building in sight appears to be very minimal. He taps his pockets, playfully searching to see if he has any pastries before pulling out a small bag of bite sized cookies. 

"There's not enough here for everyone to have thier own, so be sure to share. Next time I'll be better prepared." He says caringly before bidding Sutri a good night and departing for the cafè.
Still holding Lucy in her lap, "I would love some tea thank you." She bows her head to Demetrius
The kids devour the cookies, being sure to share  (with magical assistance from Sutri) and wave goodbye pleasantly.

Lucy's ears jolt up. She squeals as she leaps away from Vivica's lap and flies around the room, encircling Demetrius before stoping right in front his face. She smiles, purrs, and boops his nose before flying around with giggling noises.

He nods and waves his hand as a nearby chair and table move over so you both may sit down. He claps twice and a pot of hot tea appears, freshly steaming. He pours you a cup and sits down before offering Lucy a skritch or two and a small biscuit. "Don't worry it's good for you." he says to the dragon
Eliot returns from his trek outside and collapses into a chair, and allows Willow to run the cafe while he... processes.

Lucy sniffs it before slowly taking it with her mouth. She flies around him quickly before landing on his shoulder, nibbling at the biscuit. She nuzzles his cheek before flying up to the rafters for a small nap.

Vivica watches Lucy "I will be glad to get back to my regular life once we know the result of this vote. However, we do still have a war to win."  She takes a sip of the tea, "wow this is really good."
Multiple colors beam up, shining on the ceiling above as Lucy can be heard squeeling in joy as she finishes the biscuit. She spins around on the rafters before settling into a comfy spot.

He nods and sips his own cup. "It's a blend of my own devising. The plants are from the feywild but are close approximations to lavender, mint, and rose." He chuckles a little bit to himself, as the petals making up his suit flutter.
"I would like to see the Feywild one day, I think. My parents used to tell me stories of it when I was little."

He nods sadly. "There's a lot of people around here who'd like to. But all the portals we can find are one-way. Whether by accident, exile, or wanderlust, many of the fey here came from the wild and are now stuck." He smiles sadly.
She nods "Maybe after everything has calmed down and the war is over we can look for a way for people to return?"

He sighs. "I would like that, though i'm not sure yet if it's possible. I've been looking for a reliable way back for beings other than myself for a very long time and as of yet have been unsuccessful.
